source.interpretation: One record is one radiocarbon-dated burial event. Modelled 68.3% and 95.4% ranges express date uncertainty, not a continuous occupation or culture boundary. Tradition denotes the source table; the original Culture label is retained. Low-agreement events remain present and are flagged.
